items.title: Mike Evans: Questionable for Week 12
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Uiagalelei: First career start on tap for Week 12
items.text:
Uiagalelei will be the Chargers' starting quarterback against the Patriots on Sunday due to the absence of Justin Herbert (concussion), Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Purdy: Won't play in Week 12
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that Purdy (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Seahawks, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Ruled out for Sunday's game versus New England
items.text:
Herbert (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: David Montgomery: Backfield mate cleared for Week 12
items.text:
Montgomery operated as the Texans' RB1 against the Colts in Week 11, but he could see a dip in touches on offense due to the impending return of Woody Marks (concussion) for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
